{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:36:55.119
    | text      = So this is a clip from an eight hour speech that Nancy Pelosi gave in February 2018 when
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:37:04.020

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:37:07.939

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:37:19.779

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:37:24.779

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:37:29.039
    | text      = about her grandson wanting to look like his friend Antonio.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:37:32.180
    | text      = That's not the point or the context.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:37:35.380
    | text      = This is a story that she tells after reading a letter from a DACA recipient who specifically
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:37:39.880

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:37:45.899
    | text      = The point of Pelosi's story isn't that it's good that her grandson doesn't want to be
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = white, it's that it's heartening to think that maybe children don't have as much bigotry
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = weird or bad.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:38:03.899
    | text      = It's obvious why Tucker plays this kind of game with context, but the only thing that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = really matters is to understand that he's doing it because he wants the opposite.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
